changes.result: DOM snapshot/fill and AHAP direct-CDP wiring committed in 385efc83, d0a71185, 76bd8325. take_snapshot uses Accessibility.getFullAXTree; fill resolves the current snapshot backend node on the exact target session. Refs are invalidated on snapshot/navigation/fill and foreign/stale refs reject. Runner requires explicit WS endpoint, contextId, targetId and expected account SHA; no gateway/Vibe fallback. tsc and 42 focused fake tests pass; no browser action.
